register.labelZh: LEAVE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: leave off 可以表示某項活動停止;leave somebody to something 則可以表示讓某人自行繼續。；你可以不讓某人參與活動、把某個名字從名單中刪去,或不把某人牽涉進爭論。；leave something behind 可以表示遺下物品;leave the competition behind 則可以表示遠遠勝過競爭對手。；leave something in 表示不要刪去文字、圖片或影片的某部分;leave something on 則表示繼續穿戴某物。
register.summaryEn: Leave off can show that an activity stops. Leave somebody to something can show that a person is allowed to continue alone. You can leave a person out of an activity, leave a name out of a list or leave somebody out of an argument. Leave something behind can describe forgetting an object. Leave the competition behind can show that someone or something becomes much better than its rivals. Leave something in means not removing part of a text, picture or video. Leave something on means continuing to wear it.

談論遺下物品或遠遠領先

Describe different ways of not including something

questions.prompt: The faster runner soon moved far ahead of the others.
questions.promptZh: 那名較快的跑手很快便遠遠拋離其他人。
questions.answer: The faster runner soon left the others far behind.
questions.answerZh: 那名較快的跑手很快便把其他人遠遠拋在後面。

questions.answerZh: 把最後一句保留在電郵內。

questions.promptZh: 一美元買一間屋?我才不相信你!

questions.answerZh: 一美元買一間屋?得了吧!

questions.promptZh: 我們沒有讓瑪雅參加遊戲。

questions.prompt: If we do not consider the cost, the plan is good.
questions.promptZh: 如果不考慮費用,這個計劃很好。
questions.answer: Leaving the cost aside, the plan is good.
